description: SPM LTDS CIM is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. Our LTDS Stage 2 dataset provides a structured, standards‑based representation of the electricity distribution network using the Common Information Model (CIM). This dataset supports transparency, interoperability, and consistent network modelling across the energy sector. The information is published in line with regulatory requirements and includes both existing and future network conditions. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are SPM, LTDS, Long Term Development Statement, Circuit, Substation, Transformer. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
